tokens.usage: 1px outline of green buttons and tags; a hair darker than green-100.

tokens.usage: Toggle track when off; filter chip on hover.

tokens.usage: Resting filter chip fill (Material 87% black at 12% opacity over white).

tokens.usage: 1px outline of the filter popover (radius 16).

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip background; text in paper (7.9:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, links, selected states, content-type labels. 3.44:1 on white: passes for 24px+/bold-19px text, icons and borders, but small text in brand green (12–14px pill labels, links) falls under 4.5:1 — kept as designed; underline links so colour is not the only cue.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind 12px green content-type labels (2026 search).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (3.44:1 — use 16px semibold or larger on green buttons).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default body and heading colour on white, paper and surface-sunken (8.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary meta text: dates, “published by”, counts (4.3:1 on white — just under 4.5; keep to 14px+).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Overlines, subtitles in caps, placeholder text (3.2:1 on white — decorative/large only).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card outlines (2026 result cards) and dividers.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards and the second nav row.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset (3.44:1 on white — meets the 3:1 non-text floor).
